metaTitle: Privacy Policy & EULA — Five Cut Pro
metaDescription: Five Cut Pro Privacy Policy and End User License Agreement (EULA): account and TikTok data, in-app advertising, sharing creator channel information with brand partners, rights, and liability limits.
title: Privacy Policy & EULA
lawyerNotice: This document combines (A) our Privacy Policy and (B) our End User License Agreement (EULA). By downloading, installing, signing in to, or continuing to use Five Cut Pro (the mobile apps, fivecutpro.com, and related services), you confirm that you have read and agree to this document. It is not legal advice and is not a certification of compliance. Mandatory consumer protections that apply to you remain in force. The data controller is [LEGAL ENTITY NAME].

sections.title: A. PRIVACY POLICY
paragraphs: Part A explains how Five Cut Pro ("we", "us") collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects information about you when you use the App, website, and brand / KOC connection features.

sections.title: 1. Scope and controller
paragraphs: This Policy applies to: (i) the Five Cut Pro apps on iOS and Android; (ii) the marketing site at fivecutpro.com; and (iii) account, notification, template-marketplace, and in-app brand-banner features we operate.

The data controller is [LEGAL ENTITY NAME]. Privacy requests: support@fivecutpro.com. Vendors that process account or technical data on our instructions are processors, not recipients of your editing media.

sections.title: 2. Why we process data
paragraphs: Five Cut Pro helps sellers, KOCs/KOLs, and creators produce short sales videos from templates/formulas (pick a template → shoot guided shots → auto-assemble → export → post to TikTok or similar), and connects brands with suitable creators.

We process data to operate the product, personalize experience, show ads and brand banners, measure campaign performance, and recommend or share creator-channel information with brand partners under commercial collaboration programs.

sections.title: 3. Categories of information
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the App, we may process:
bullets: Account data: email, OTP codes, Google/TikTok sign-in details, display name, avatar, language, notification settings, guest or signed-in status.

TikTok / creator-channel profile (when you link or sign in with TikTok): open_id/union_id, username, display name, avatar, bio, profile deep link, verification status, public or API-granted stats (followers, following, likes, video count), and similar fields needed to identify you as a creator.
In-app activity metadata (not your media files): templates or formulas you view, save, or use; counts of exports; brand-banner impressions and clicks; optional campaign participation.
Your videos, photos, and audio for local editing stay on your device. See Section 8. We do not receive those files for local editing.

Device and technical data used to run the service: device type, operating system, app version, push-notification token (Firebase Cloud Messaging), coarse IP or region where our servers see a request, and similar operational logs tied to accounts or API calls. We do not describe crash-report or mobile-advertising-ID collection because the current app build does not use a crash-reporting SDK or a mobile ads SDK that reads those identifiers.
Support communications you send via email, forms, or published support channels.
Website data: cookies/local storage, locale, referrer, and basic analytics events on fivecutpro.com.

sections.title: 4. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: We process account and technical data to: provide and secure accounts; sync templates, formulas, and marketplace activity that you choose to save online; send notices; display and measure in-app brand banners; and, where you link a channel, support brand–creator matching as described in Sections 6–7. Combining shots into a video happens on your device and is not a server process.

Legal bases may include: performance of our licence/service contract with you; our and our commercial partners’ legitimate interests (template marketplace, advertising, KOC–brand matching) balanced against your rights; consent where required (certain cookies, ad IDs, or expanded sharing); and legal obligations.
Users in Vietnam: processing may engage Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP and related guidance. EEA/UK users: GDPR Article 6(1)(a)/(b)/(c)/(f) may apply as appropriate.

sections.title: 5. In-app / website advertising, brand banners, and measurement
paragraphs: Five Cut Pro may show advertisements, brand banners, sponsored content, or promotions from brands/partners in the App and on the website (for example discovery, home, creation flows, and export screens).

To run and bill partnerships by impressions or campaign performance, we may collect and process: impression counts, clicks/engagement, placement, timing, device/app version, campaign IDs, and metrics that are aggregated or account/channel-linked when needed for brand reporting.
Brand banners may be chosen using language, approximate region, or in-app category interest. They are served by our systems, not by a third-party mobile advertising network in the current app.
Continued use of the App means you accept in-app/website advertising and our use of the measurement data above to operate, optimize, and settle with advertising/brand partners.

sections.title: 6. Brand–KOC connection and sharing channel information
paragraphs: A core part of Five Cut Pro is connecting brands and creators: brands place products/templates/shooting guides into the ecosystem; KOCs pick templates, learn shooting flows, and create content; brands reach relevant KOCs for campaigns.

When you sign in with TikTok, we receive the profile fields that login returns (such as open_id, display name, avatar, username, bio, public profile link, and public stats such as follower and video counts). We use those fields to identify your account. We do not upload the videos, photos, or audio on your device as part of that sign-in.

Separate from local editing, the product can show brand banners inside the app. Impression and click counts for those banners are stored so a campaign can be measured. A channel profile is not sent to a brand merely because you edit a video.

If a campaign later asks you to be introduced to a brand, the app must say which profile fields would be shared before you join. That sharing is not part of local editing, and it never includes your on-device media files.

sections.title: 7. Sharing with third parties
paragraphs: We may share data with:
bullets: Brands shown in in-app banners — impression and click counts for campaigns we operate. Not your editing media, and not an automatic copy of your TikTok profile.

Infrastructure vendors that host our API, send email one-time codes, or deliver push notifications (Google Firebase Cloud Messaging). They receive the technical data needed for that task, not your editing media.

Sign-in and share platforms you choose: Google (Google Sign-In) and TikTok (login and share). They receive the authentication data their SDKs require. Sharing a finished video to TikTok is an action you start; that share goes to TikTok under TikTok’s terms, not to our servers as an upload of the project.
Public authorities when legally required, or to protect rights, safety, and property of us or users.
Successors in a restructuring, merger, or investment (subject to equivalent confidentiality).
paragraphsAfterBullets: We do not sell user lists to unrelated data brokers. Commercial sharing with brands/advertising partners inside the Five Cut Pro product (banners, KOC matching, campaign reporting) is done under this Policy and is not intended as “selling data” in the cold-list brokerage sense — unless local law defines otherwise, in which case we will add any required choice mechanisms.

sections.title: 8. Your media stays on your device
paragraphs: Five Cut Pro’s local video editing features process your videos, photos, and audio on your device. Those media files are not uploaded to, stored on, or processed by Five Cut Pro servers for local editing or export. They are not used to train AI models. The current product does not send your editing media to an AI provider.

What stays on the device includes source clips, photos, music or other audio you import, project files, and exported videos, unless you separately choose to share an export with a third-party app such as TikTok.

Account data, sign-in tokens, template and formula records you save to your account, push tokens, banner impression logs, and website analytics are not “local media.” Those categories are handled by our servers or the third parties named in this Policy.
Deleting your Five Cut Pro account does not delete files that remain in your device storage or camera roll. See the Delete Account page.

sections.title: 9. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: fivecutpro.com uses: (i) cookies or similar storage that the site needs for language and basic page operation; and (ii) Google Analytics 4, which sets analytics cookies and receives page and event data (such as pages viewed and button clicks) to understand site use. We do not use a separate marketing-cookie platform on the website. You can block cookies in your browser; analytics and some preferences may then not work. The mobile app does not use those website cookies.

sections.title: 10. International transfers, security, and retention
paragraphs: Servers or vendors may be located outside your country of residence. We apply appropriate safeguards required by applicable law (contracts, technical and organizational measures).
We use reasonable security measures; no system is perfectly secure. Protect your devices and do not share OTPs/passwords.

Account and operational records are kept while your account is active and, after a deletion request, through the deactivation window described on the Delete Account page (currently 7 days), then deactivated. We may keep limited records longer where needed for security, dispute handling, or legal and accounting duties. Exact secondary retention periods are [DATA RETENTION PERIODS]. Local media on your device is not in our retention schedule because we do not hold it.

sections.title: 11. Your rights
paragraphs: Where the law that applies to you provides them, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, and a portable copy, and you may withdraw consent where we rely on consent. These rights apply to personal data we hold (account, channel profile, operational logs). They do not delete media that only exists on your device.

You may unlink TikTok and turn off push notifications in the app or the operating system. EEA and UK users may complain to a supervisory authority. California residents may have rights to know, delete, and correct personal information, and to opt out of “sale” or “sharing” as those terms are defined in the CCPA/CPRA. We do not sell personal information for money. Contact support@fivecutpro.com if you want to opt out of any campaign use of profile information, if such a campaign is offered to you.
Requests: support@fivecutpro.com. We will verify identity before fulfilling sensitive requests. Vietnamese users may also rely on Decree 13/2023/NĐ-CP where it applies.

sections.title: 12. Children
paragraphs: The service is not directed at children under 13 (or a higher minimum age required locally). Do not provide children’s data. Contact us to delete information collected in error.

sections.title: 13. Changes to the Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update Part A when the product, brand-partnership model, or law changes. Material changes will be notice via app, website, or email where appropriate. Continued use after the effective date means acceptance, unless local law requires a separate consent.

sections.title: B. END USER LICENSE AGREEMENT (EULA)
paragraphs: Part B is a binding software licence between you and the operator of Five Cut Pro ("Licensor"). This EULA is an inseparable part of Five Cut Pro’s legal terms; accepting this document means accepting the EULA.

sections.title: 14. Acceptance of the EULA
paragraphs: By downloading, installing, opening, signing in, activating, or continuing to use the App, you accept Part B (EULA) and Part A (Privacy). If you do not agree, uninstall the App and stop using it.

paragraphs: Subject to this document and applicable law, we grant you a limited, personal (or for the organization you lawfully represent), non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to install and run legitimate copies of the App on devices you own or control, to create lawful video content and use marketplace / brand-collaboration features we provide.
bullets: No ownership of the App is transferred — only use rights.
Each account/licence may only be used within its granted scope.
Reasonable backup copies for personal/archival use are allowed.

sections.title: 16. Restrictions
paragraphs: Except where mandatory law allows otherwise, you must not: sell/rent/sublicense the App; copy or create unauthorized derivatives; reverse engineer beyond lawful limits; remove proprietary notices; bypass security/licence controls; use the App to build a competing product by systematically cloning our proprietary workflows/templates; or abuse systems with bots.

sections.title: 17. User Content, templates, and publishing responsibility
paragraphs: You keep ownership of videos, photos, audio, music, and other content you create or import. We do not receive a licence to store, process, or transmit that media for local editing, because it does not leave your device for that purpose. If you later publish a template or other material to the marketplace, you grant us only the rights needed to host and display that published template.

You are responsible for having the rights and licences you need for videos, photos, music, fonts, logos, product images, and other copyrighted material, especially where you create commercial content. You are also responsible for trademark, publicity, advertising, consumer-protection, and platform rules when you export and publish.
Templates, formulas, shooting guides, and automation tools are productivity aids only; they do not guarantee algorithmic approval, sales, brand deals, or immunity from platform enforcement.

sections.title: 18. Advertising and brand programs (service terms)
paragraphs: You agree that the App and website may contain ads, banners, and sponsored content. We may change placements, frequency, and advertising partners.

When you join brand campaigns (viewing info, receiving samples/products, creating content to brief, or being proposed to brands), you acknowledge that channel information may be shared under Section 6 and that you alone are responsible for obligations to the brand under any separate agreement. Five Cut Pro is a connection/workflow platform; unless a separate written contract says otherwise, we do not guarantee income, deal volume, or negotiation outcomes between you and a brand.
Brands may place product imagery, logos, and identity into templates/shooting guides. Using those templates does not assign brand IP to you beyond what the campaign permits.

sections.title: 19. Third-party services
paragraphs: Google (sign-in and, on the website, Analytics), TikTok (sign-in and share), Apple and Google app stores, our hosting providers, Firebase Cloud Messaging, and brand partners have their own terms. They do not receive your on-device editing media from us. We do not control their decisions, including social-account actions or content refusals.

sections.title: 20. Intellectual property
paragraphs: The App, UI, documentation, Five Cut Pro logos, and formula/template systems we supply remain ours or our licensors’. Feedback you send may be used to improve the product without royalty obligations, unless a separate agreement says otherwise.

WHERE LIABILITY CANNOT BE EXCLUDED, OUR TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ALL CLAIMS RELATING TO THIS DOCUMENT OR THE APP SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES YOU ACTUALLY PAID US IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS BEFORE THE CLAIM AND (B) FIFTY US DOLLARS (USD $50), OR THE MINIMUM AMOUNT REQUIRED BY MANDATORY LAW IF HIGHER.
Your primary remedy is to stop using and uninstall the App.

sections.title: 23. Indemnity
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, you will indemnify us against claims arising from your content, publications, breach of this document or law, or disputes with brands/platforms/rights-holders — except to the extent caused by our wilful unlawful conduct where non-waivable.

sections.title: 24. Termination
paragraphs: You may terminate by uninstalling and/or deleting your account. We may suspend or terminate use rights for material breach, abuse, or legal requirements. IP, disclaimer, liability, indemnity, and governing-law provisions survive termination.

sections.title: 25. Governing law, EULA changes, and contact
paragraphs: If you reside in Vietnam, this document is governed by Vietnamese law; disputes should first be negotiated in good faith, then may be brought before competent Vietnamese courts, subject to mandatory consumer protections. If you reside elsewhere, non-waivable local rights still apply.
We may update Part B together with or separately from Part A; notice follows Section 13.
